events.summary: Jazal Goldmane says that when one prospers the pride prospers.
events.quote: "When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."

events.summary: General Avitora laments that her barricades and war elephants failed against a force a tenth of her number.
events.quote: "Impossible! How could they overwhelm us?

events.summary: Ludevic comments on a grim way to go.
events.quote: "I can think of worse ways to go.

events.summary: Jace Beleren reflects that his greatest imagined achievements were only first steps.
events.quote: "The things I once imagined would be my greatest achievements were only the first steps toward a future I can only begin to fathom."

events.summary: Tezzeret grafted the Planar Bridge into himself and felt his spark flare beyond his body.
events.quote: When I grafted the Planar Bridge into myself I felt my Planeswalker spark flare beyond my body.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas would not rest until restored to his former glory.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas would not rest until he was restored to his former glory.

events.summary: Jace Beleren warns of the terror of breaking another's mind.
events.quote: "To break another's mind is to deliver a fate worse than death.

events.summary: The Great Mending healed the Multiverse and unraveled the threads of Nicol Bolas's power.
events.quote: The Great Mending that healed the Multiverse also unraveled the threads of Nicol Bolas's power.

events.summary: Isareth the Awakener rouses the dead to work.
events.quote: "Rise and shine, my dears. We have work to do."

events.summary: An intruder declares Zendikar will be his throne, palace, and playground once intruders are gone.
events.quote: "When these intruders are gone, Zendikar will be my throne, my palace, my playground."

events.summary: Liliana Vess commands the dead to obey.
events.quote: "Death is no excuse for disobedience."

events.summary: Queen Lian offers serenity to a knight as a prize for giving all to the kingdom.
events.quote: "You have given all to your kingdom, dear knight. Serenity shall be your prize."

events.summary: Queen Lian promises reward for service.
events.quote: "Your service shall be rewarded."

events.summary: Nicol Bolas voices his will to be done.
events.quote: "As I desire, so it shall be."

events.summary: Ash Kronor demands kneeling even if he must split the earth.
events.quote: "You will kneel before me, even if I have to split the earth under your feet!"

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol wonders whether unwelcome thoughts are his madness or another's whispers.
events.quote: "Unwelcome thoughts crowd my mind.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas destroyed Vivien's world, so she celebrates all life in honor of Skalla.
events.quote: "Nicol Bolas destroyed my world.

events.summary: Palladia-Mors is identified as Nicol Bolas's sister and a survivor of the Elder Dragon War.
events.quote: Sister of Nicol Bolas. Survivor of the Elder Dragon War.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas claims all as his own.
events.quote: "I do as I choose with what is mine. And it is all mine."

events.summary: Ajani Goldmane credits the healers of Bant for his tutelage.
events.quote: "The healers of Bant are second to none.

events.summary: Tezzeret calls his strider obedient.
events.quote: "More obedient than any dog."

events.summary: Liliana Vess prefers fresh corpses.
events.quote: "I'm not picky about what comes up, but the less decay, the better."

events.summary: Sarkhan wandered into a tomb and back in time.
events.quote: Sarkhan wandered into a tomb and back in time.

events.summary: The Cabal legions pushed into Shiv.
events.quote: As the Cabal legions pushed into Shiv, they learned not to stand so close together.

relations.quote: I owe it to Skalla to celebrate all life
